description: 50 reviewed independent microtasks across six owned Java domains. Multiple same-domain proposals remain isolated until review; this is an optional scaling backlog, not a command to spend.

tasks.goal: Correct objective counters so completed objectives never display overflow such as 3/2; verify lock-on target acquisition and combat state invariants in WorldState.
Improve sword swing phases, fluid forward attack arc and clear impact timing while preserving dodge, idle and stamina behavior in CombatMotion and CharacterRig.
Improve hero and enemy silhouettes, armor layering, hands and boots, and reduce blocky geometry with efficient deterministic mesh structures.
Add controlled roughness, metal and leather detail and more believable material sampling within native GLES2 texture and atlas budgets.
Improve flagstone and ruins geometry variation, terrain details and static asset batching without increasing runtime mesh regeneration.
Refine the Model Atelier asset registry, camera framing and orbit controls with testable, stable real-emulator navigation.
Make lock-on discard dead, missing or out-of-range targets without changing the camera unexpectedly.
Keep ash-sigil progress monotonic and never greater than REQUIRED_SIGILS in WorldState snapshots.
Make every defeated foe increment totalKills at most once even if its death routine is revisited.
Keep checkpoint and respawn transitions consistent with already collected objectives.
Ensure each sword sweep registers no more than one damage event per target.
Guard stamina, HP and invulnerability timers against negative or NaN values.
Prevent a defeated boss from re-entering attacks after the victory state activates.
Bound green impact-stain pool occupancy, lifetimes and placement without reallocating per frame.
Ensure bladeBearing follows one smooth right-to-left front arc and has continuous endpoints.
Refine attack wind-up, active contact and recovery transitions without moving the hit-window behind the character.
Check collision sweep windows detect a crossing hit even with coarse frame delta.
Prevent hits on targets behind the player with clear angle and range bounds.
Improve pure-Java exertion and idle breathing pose blend signals without adding allocations.
Normalize dodge and attack easing near start and end so poses do not snap.
Make animation helper functions remain finite and deterministic at extreme input values.
Improve deterministic mesh normal validity and reject degenerate high-detail triangles.
Refine the generated hero boot, gauntlet and hand silhouette without changing gameplay hitbox.
Improve triangle winding consistency for armor panels and sculpted geometry.
Add boss model silhouette details while preserving low-poly fallback geometry.
Review OBJ loader parser handling of invalid or missing normals and UVs.
Generate finer armor engraving geometry with bounded vertex and memory counts.
Reduce obvious mesh seams in character shoulders, elbows and helmet joins.
Add subtle, bounded leather grain variation for character equipment material maps.
Improve steel edge wear and roughness response while preserving low-end GLES2 constraints.
Validate material atlas offsets, dimensions and texture coordinates against bounds.
Improve cloth weave variation and avoid high-frequency aliasing at medium distance.
Introduce controlled brass patina for relic and helmet accents.
Ensure tileable stone albedo maps do not show obvious repetition.
Constrain surface texture generator memory allocations and deterministic seed behavior.
Vary flagstone outline, tilt and chipped corners while preserving collision readability.
Enhance masonry course offsets and ruin wall stone silhouette variation.
Improve prop and rubble scatter density with a fixed geometry budget.
Refine procedural dead roots with taper, branching and grounded root flares.
Give destroyed chapel stones plausible broken faces and nonuniform edges.
Add limited erosion channels and moss patches that respond to stone orientation.
Check world mesh bounds and skip degenerate triangles before geometry assembly.
Use deterministic environmental variations instead of expensive per-frame random rebuilding.
Test studio orbit yaw wrapping and ensure turns remain finite through repeated rotations.
Improve studio camera pitch clamps without flipping or rolling the model.
Refine close-up zoom range to reveal hands and material detail without clipping.
Preserve item index and framing correctly when switching forward and backward.
Improve closeup focus presets for boss versus hero models.
Keep light and material preset cycling deterministic at every wraparound.
Ensure studio reset restores a consistent viewing angle and camera pan.
